---
title: "precipitation analysis"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(readr)

```

**In order to use this file, you need to run the cropviz.qmd file in the repo far enough that you have a usable all_stations dataframe.**

```{r}
ggplot(all_stations, aes(x = TDIF, y = PRCP, color = TAVG)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.05) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```

```{r}
wm1 <- lm(PRCP ~ LATITUDE * LONGITUDE, data = filter(all_stations, TDIF>= -100))
wm2 <- lm(PRCP ~ TDIF + LATITUDE * LONGITUDE, data = all_stations)
summary(wm1)
summary(wm2)
```

```{r}
anova(with(all_stations,wm1), with(all_stations,wm2))
```
